review_description: I installed with this company, the job was perfect and the team was very helpful and professional. I have no regrets. I give them 5 stars.They helped with grid connection as well.

Super cheap installation with quality Jinko and sungrow equipment which worksHowever:- Poor customer service with bait and switch of inverter: setting up non-hybrid but at point of sale saying hybrid inverter- Incorrect inverter installed initially which I believe would've been missed if I hadn't looked at the app. Likely Deliberate- I then had to pay an extra $1000 for the hybrid inverter which I requested which was agreed upon initially- No setting up isolar app- No setting teaching on isolar app- Fractured tile(s)- discovered by independent contracted solar company- Multiple excuses made to follow up to fix consumption meter (advised myself to contact sungrow with no follow up by himself and ?incorrect misleading information given)- Causing stress and spending extra to fix his mistakesOverall: would have paid extra for quality products, actual coverage if damages with quality installation and good long customer service.
